title: How to Neutralize Dog Urine Smell in Couch Cushions Naturally
description: Learn how to remove dog urine odor from couch cushions with a careful fabric-safe process and when an enzymatic cleaner is the better choice.
keywords: get dog pee smell out of couch fabric
imageAlt: How to Neutralize Dog Urine Smell in Couch Cushions Naturally - topic-matched home care photo
content:
Dog urine odor can linger in couch cushions because liquid can travel below the surface fabric. Simply spraying fragrance over the area may hide the smell temporarily while leaving the source behind. The right method depends on the cushion fabric, the care label and how deeply the urine penetrated.

The Quick Answer

Blot fresh urine immediately, remove washable covers if permitted, and use a fabric-safe enzymatic pet-odor cleaner according to its label for urine contamination. For delicate or non-washable upholstery, test first or call a professional upholstery cleaner.

Step 1: Find the Full Affected Area

Urine can spread beyond the visible spot. Use your nose and inspect seams, cushion edges and the area beneath removable covers. If the cushion has a removable insert, check both sides.

Step 2: Blot, Do Not Scrub

For fresh accidents, press clean absorbent towels into the fabric to lift as much liquid as possible. Do not rub aggressively because that can push contamination deeper into the cushion.

Step 3: Check the Upholstery Label

Look for the manufacturer's upholstery cleaning code. Different fabrics have different water tolerances. If the label indicates professional cleaning only, do not saturate the cushion with a homemade solution.

Step 4: Use an Enzymatic Cleaner When Appropriate

Pet urine contains compounds that can remain odorous after ordinary surface cleaning. A purpose-made enzymatic pet cleaner can help break down organic residue when used as directed. Apply enough to reach the affected area without soaking beyond what the upholstery can safely handle.

Step 5: Dry Thoroughly

Ventilate the room and allow the cushion to dry completely. A damp cushion can develop additional musty odors. Do not use high heat on upholstery unless the manufacturer permits it.

What About Vinegar and Baking Soda?

These ingredients are popular online, but a homemade mixture is not automatically the best choice for upholstery. Acidity, moisture and residue can affect dyes and finishes. If you choose any DIY method, patch-test first and follow the fabric manufacturer's instructions.

If the Smell Returns

A returning odor can mean urine reached the foam or inner padding. At that point, surface treatment may not be enough. A professional upholstery cleaner may be able to treat the cushion more deeply, or the affected insert may need replacement in severe cases.

Pet-Friendly Prevention

Wash removable covers according to their care instructions, use washable throws on favorite pet spots and clean accidents promptly. If accidents are frequent, discuss possible medical or behavioral causes with your veterinarian.

Safety

Keep pets and children away from treated areas until the product label says they can safely return. Never mix cleaning chemicals.

FAQ

Can baking soda remove dog urine smell from a couch?
It may absorb some surface odor, but it cannot reliably remove urine that has penetrated the cushion.

What is best for old dog urine smell?
A suitable enzymatic pet-odor cleaner or professional upholstery treatment is often more appropriate than fragrance alone.

Why does the smell return when the cushion gets damp?
Moisture can reactivate odor from residue deeper inside the fabric or cushion.
